label: semi_ocr
name: Semi OCR Image Category Classification
description: Classify a semi-OCR image into exactly one content category based on its visual layout, interface, graphics, and readable-text context.

labels.messaging: Chat and conversation screenshots from messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Slack, Teams, Messenger, or Discord.
labels.social_media: Social media posts, stories, comments, profiles, feeds, or discussion threads from platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, or YouTube.
labels.email: Email messages, inboxes, conversation threads, compose screens, newsletters, or promotional emails.
labels.browser: Web browser content such as webpages, search results, articles, blogs, forums, wiki pages, login pages, or general websites.
labels.application: Mobile or desktop application screens that do not fit a more specific category.
labels.productivity: Document editors, spreadsheets, calendars, task managers, note-taking applications, project boards, or file-management tools.
labels.development: Code editors, IDEs, API clients, database tools, Git applications, debuggers, or developer dashboards.
labels.terminal: Command-line interfaces, shell output, server logs, application logs, build output, or system consoles.
labels.ecommerce: Online shopping content such as product pages, product listings, carts, checkout screens, order confirmations, or order tracking.
labels.maps_and_navigation: Maps, route directions, navigation screens, traffic information, place details, transit maps, or location searches.
labels.media: Video players, music players, streaming services, podcast players, photo galleries, live streams, or media libraries.
labels.settings: Device, application, account, privacy, security, notification, network, permission, or configuration screens.
labels.game: Gameplay screenshots, game menus, inventories, maps, scoreboards, character screens, or game results containing meaningful interface text.
labels.presentation: Presentation slides where text, images, charts, diagrams, and layout communicate information together.
labels.publication: Book, textbook, magazine, newspaper, journal, comic-book, or other published pages where text and visual content are both important.
labels.poster: Event, educational, awareness, recruitment, entertainment, or public-information posters.
labels.advertisement: Promotional visual content advertising a product, service, event, offer, or brand.
labels.brochure: Structured promotional or informational material containing multiple text sections, images, and designed layouts.
labels.infographic: A visual explanation combining text, icons, charts, diagrams, statistics, timelines, or process steps.
labels.menu: Restaurant, cafe, food-delivery, drinks, service, salon, or pricing menus.
labels.product_packaging: Product boxes, bottles, wrappers, containers, or labels containing branding and product information.
labels.meme: Humorous or cultural content where text and an image work together to communicate the meaning.
labels.comic: Comic panels, illustrated stories, speech bubbles, manga pages, comic strips, or webcomics containing readable text.
labels.whiteboard: A photograph of handwritten notes, equations, diagrams, plans, or brainstorming content on a board.
labels.sign: Road signs, warning signs, safety signs, shop signs, information boards, banners, public notices, or digital signage.
labels.other: Mixed, unclear, unreadable, or unmatched semi-OCR content that does not fit another category.
